summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Integration jobs must target `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is retired and hangs.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so reminder emails are not sent to customers who already paid. Router splitting is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Orders: `orders_v1`, `orders_v2`, alias `orders`; cluster `production` is yellow. CI label: `ci-runner-small` (retired; use `ci-runner-arm64`). `orders_v1` maps only `id` as keyword. Usage events use `list(batch)`. Canonical CLI fields are `args.currency` and `args.status`; nested `args.filters` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Popping pending events before persistence loses retryable events. Shared `extend(batch)` retains aliasing. `_last_batch` retains charged events. Wrapping webhook handlers in a five-attempt retry decorator re-sent customer emails; ruled out.

## Recent work
Webhook retries were implemented and validated: 44 tests pass, Ruff passes, and the diff is clean. Indexing baseline has 18 passing and 2 failing tests because rebuilt documents miss recently updated invoice descriptions; rebuilds currently embed invoices page by page.
